info.description: Location discovery platform. Generated from the Zod schemas that validate requests at runtime — do not edit by hand.

Verifies the database is reachable and PostGIS is available. Returns 503 when degraded — a database without PostGIS cannot serve any discovery query.

post.description: Sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. The refresh token is never returned in the body — JavaScript must not be able to read it.

Sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. The refresh token is never returned in the body — JavaScript must not be able to read it. Responds identically for an unknown email and a wrong password, in the same amount of time, so account existence cannot be probed.

Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh cookie. Every rotation retires the previous token. Presenting an already-rotated token outside a short race window is treated as theft and revokes the entire token family — the client should sign the user out on AUTH_REFRESH_REUSE_DETECTED rather than retrying.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Always succeeds, even without a valid session — never an oracle for token validity.

get.description: Two-level category tree with approved-place counts. Counts include places filed under a subcategory, so a parent total is never smaller than the sum of its children.

get.description: Location-scoped and cursor-paginated. There is no way to request every place: a radius (max 50 km) and a limit (max 100) are always applied. Falls back to the Ho Chi Minh City centre when no coordinates are given.

post.description: Always lands in PENDING, including for administrators — §9 requires review before anything is published, and an admin bypass would mean the most phishable account is also the one that can publish unreviewed.

items.description: One entry per shift. Split hours are two entries for the same day. A closing time at or before the opening time is stored as crossing midnight.

get.description: Distance-ranked. Uses ST_DWithin against the GiST index, then a KNN sort.

Returns a deliberately minimal marker shape rather than full cards — a viewport can hold hundreds of markers whose detail the user cannot read. Fetch the card on marker tap. `meta.capped` is true when the viewport held more than the limit, so the client can prompt the user to zoom in.
Combines weighted full-text search with trigram word similarity, both diacritic-insensitive: "ca phe", "cà phê" and "marbl" all match. Searches our own catalogue, never a third-party places API.

Aggregated over the last 30 days from real search history. Queries that returned nothing are excluded — suggesting a search that finds nothing is worse than suggesting nothing. Returns an empty array until enough searches have been recorded, so clients should fall back to browsing by category.

Accepts a UUID or a slug. A non-approved place is visible only to its owner, its submitter, or an admin; everyone else receives 404 rather than 403, since 403 would confirm the place exists and allow pending submissions to be enumerated.

canEdit.description: Whether the caller may submit changes

patch.description: An owner editing a published listing creates a PlaceRevision and receives 202 — the live listing is untouched until an admin approves. Editing a place still awaiting its first approval applies directly and returns 200. Administrators always write directly. The slug is immutable after publication, since changing it breaks every shared link.
